say:2:1041573101:1.text: Oh? I thought I felt a pair of curious eyes on me. Were you peeking through that lotus leaf the whole time?
say:2:1041573101:1.source_cn: 我注意到你一直用荷叶遮着脸，在叶子的缝隙里悄悄看我呢。

say:3:1041573102:1.text: There's no need to hide, dear. If something's on your mind, you're always welcome to share it with me.
say:3:1041573102:1.source_cn: 是有什么心事想分享吗，小姑娘？尽管向我倾诉好了。

say:4:1041573103:1.text: Ah, s-sorry... I didn't mean to stare...
say:4:1041573103:1.source_cn: 啊，对不起……我不是故意要偷看的……

say:5:1041573104:1.text: It's just... you smell really nice. Like sunlight and dew soaking into leaves...
say:5:1041573104:1.source_cn: 只是，您身上有股很好闻的气息，是阳光和露水浸透树叶的味道……

say:6:1041573105:1.text: Hehe. What a lovely way to put it. I suppose that comes from spending my days surrounded by plants in the Skyrealm Forest.
say:6:1041573105:1.source_cn: 呵呵，也许是我每天都在空境森林照看植物的缘故吧。

say:7:1041573106:1.text: When you care for them long enough, their calm seems to follow you wherever you go.
say:7:1041573106:1.source_cn: 与它们相伴久了，呼吸都会变得和它们一样清新。

say:8:1041573107:1.text: The Skyrealm Forest... It sounds really pretty.

say:9:1041573108:1.text: It is. There are many plants there, including some bellflowers we brought over from the Dark Forest. I have a feeling you'd like them.
say:9:1041573108:1.source_cn: 那里有许多植物，你一定会喜欢那几株从薄暮丛林移栽的铃兰花。

say:10:1041573109:0.text: Lately, though, they've been a bit down. Their leaves curl in as if they're tired, no matter what I try.
say:10:1041573109:0.source_cn: 可最近不知为什么，它们总是无精打采地蜷着叶片。

say:11:1041573110:0.text: I've adjusted the soil's mana and cast nourishing spells, but they still don't seem happy.
say:11:1041573110:0.source_cn: 我试过调整土壤的魔力浓度，还施过滋养咒语，却始终不见好转。

say:12:1041573111:0.source_cn: 薄暮丛林的植物……对水很挑剔。

say:13:1041573112:0.text: They're very picky about water. They need rain that comes like the tide—not too much, not too little.
say:13:1041573112:0.source_cn: 需要潮汐节律般的雨水，不能多，也不能少。

say:14:1041573113:0.text: Ah, that's it! You've noticed something important. I managed the magic, but I couldn't recreate that natural rhythm.
say:14:1041573113:0.source_cn: 你说到了关键！我试过调节灌溉魔法，但差了些自然的韵律。

say:15:1041573114:1.text: Sometimes plants listen better to kindness than to spells. And you... you have such a gentle, balanced presence. It might be exactly what they're waiting for.
say:15:1041573114:1.source_cn: 我能感觉到，你身上有一种温柔而协调的气息，或许正是它们...

say:16:1041573115:1.text: Would you like to visit the Skyrealm Forest with me sometime? Only if you feel comfortable, of course.
say:16:1041573115:1.source_cn: 你原意来空境森林帮帮忙吗？

say:17:1041573116:1.text: I... I usually just take care of little flowers by the lake... I've never been anywhere like the Serene Lyceum before.
say:17:1041573116:1.source_cn: 我……其实常在湖边照料小花小草，但从没进过莱希拉姆魔法...

say:18:1041573117:1.source_cn: 虽然有些难为情……不过我真的很好奇，那里会是什么样子……

say:19:1041573118:1.text: Oh, don't worry about that. There are no tests, just a few plants that could use a friend.
say:19:1041573118:1.source_cn: 别担心，那里没有评分和考试，只有几株需要你的植物朋友。

say:20:1041573119:1.text: You can come at dusk. It's the calmest time of the day. I'll be there, and the fireflies will light the path for us.
say:20:1041573119:1.source_cn: 你可以黄昏时来，那时最安静，我会携着萤火虫一起迎接你的。

say:21:1041573120:1.text: Even if the flowers don't recover, that's perfectly fine. We can simply walk through the forest together.
say:21:1041573120:1.source_cn: 哪怕没能治好它们也没关系，我们可以一起参观空境森林。

say:22:1041573121:1.text: And afterward, I'll make you some of my special herbal tea. I add a little glowing honey, it's very soothing.
say:22:1041573121:1.source_cn: 对了，你一定会喜欢我特调的花草茶，里面加了会发光的蜂蜜哦。

say:23:1041573122:0.text: O-okay... I think I'd like that. I'll come at dusk!
say:23:1041573122:0.source_cn: 好吧……我……我会去试试看的……在黄昏时！
